settings.answer_3:
Complete Ingredient List & Why Each Matters:

Selenium (200mcg)
Essential for T4 to T3 conversion. Your body needs selenium to build deiodinase enzymes that activate thyroid hormone. Most people with thyroid issues are severely deficient.

Iodine (100mcg)

The building block of thyroid hormones. Our precise 2:1 selenium-to-iodine ratio ensures optimal hormone production without triggering autoimmune flare-ups.

Zinc (15mg)
Critical for thyroid receptor function. Even with adequate hormone levels, zinc deficiency prevents your cells from actually using the thyroid hormone available.

L-Tyrosine (500mg)
The amino acid precursor your thyroid uses to manufacture hormones. Supports mental clarity and helps combat brain fog.

Ashwagandha (300mg)
Adaptogenic herb that helps regulate stress hormones (cortisol) which can block thyroid function. Reduces inflammation and protects thyroid tissue.

Vitamin B12 (Methylcobalamin - 100mcg)
Active form for better absorption. Supports energy production and helps reverse the fatigue associated with poor thyroid function.

Magnesium (50mg)
Required for over 300 enzymatic reactions including thyroid hormone production and T4 to T3 conversion.

Copper (1mg)
Works synergistically with zinc for optimal thyroid receptor sensitivity. Proper copper-zinc balance is crucial.

Manganese (2mg)
Supports thyroid hormone synthesis and protects against oxidative stress that damages thyroid tissue.

Vitamin D3 (1000 IU)
Modulates immune function and reduces thyroid antibodies in autoimmune conditions like Hashimoto's.
